verdict: HH in the permanent-water zone changed only +0.4 dB (HV +0.2 dB) between 17 July and August after removing the stable-reference offset, so wind does not explain it; the drop remains unexplained. Note the 17 July NISAR scene is paired with the only Landsat-9 DSWx-HLS product (19 July); all other pairs are Sentinel-2.
